card.name: Adjective before a noun like intake
card.fires_on: A modifier word such as oral, air, visual or oil that comes right before a noun it describes. The strongest case is "oral" in "resumed oral intake" in drug labels.

modes.label: Oral before intake or drug
modes.description: The word oral after resumed or weekly, ahead of intake or a drug name.

modes.label: General web nouns
modes.description: A noun or adjective like air, visual or oil in general web text, shortly before a following noun or a list.
modes.example: contamination to our<< air>>, land, and water resources.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens; the suppressed ones are mostly slash forms like /her and /month.
card.plain: It fires on a describing word like "oral" just before the noun it goes with, as in "resumed oral intake".
